description: LCT Datasets Postal Districts is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our LCT Datasets Postal Districts dataset gives the number of Low Carbon Technology (LCT) installations for each postal district on Northern Powergrid's network. The dataset also includes LCT penetration in that area, i.e. the number of LCT installations compared to the number of services in that area. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Net Zero Future. Its keywords are Low Carbon Technologies (LCT), Methodology. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
